test.hint: Courseplay on, with a custom field saved. Field loop tool: click inside that custom field. This ticks by itself.

test.title: The loop follows the custom field

test.title: Toggle off uses the old boundary
test.hint: Press Q (undo). Turn Courseplay field off on the card. Click the same spot again. This ticks by itself.

test.title: One undo removes the whole loop
test.hint: Press Q (undo) once. The whole loop is gone, nothing else changed. Turn Courseplay field back on. PASS if so.
